intro.text: A title from Threnody, first held by the leader who brought a group of Threnodites to Canticle to escape strife at home.
An appointed leader on Canticle who steers a city along its route. The title began with the leader who brought the first Threnodites to Canticle.

description.text: In some cities the Lodestar also guides long-term plans. On Beacon, the Lodestar is chosen by a vote of the Greater Good.

items.text: The first Lodestar led a group of Threnodites from Threnody to Canticle, escaping the strife there.
